rationale: The agent verified identity using full name + zip and matched a single account. It retrieved the user’s recent delivered order, confirmed that exchanges are possible, and pulled product variant data. For the coffee machine, it correctly determined 8 and 7 bar were unavailable and presented 9-bar options, including one that matched the original capacity/type; the user explicitly chose a different 9-bar variant, which is acceptable. For the laptop, it identified the cheapest available i7-or-above option correctly. The agent summarized the exact changes and payment handling, requested explicit confirmation, then performed the exchange using the correct item IDs and the user’s preferred gift card. Final information (net refund $121.17 to gift card, exchange requested status, return instructions via email) matches tool outputs. No unsupported claims, no actions without confirmation, and acted only on the authenticated user’s order.
